name: Thabo
face: Thabo is an eight-year-old Basotho boy with warm medium-brown skin, a round face, large dark brown eyes, soft brows, short black curls, and a bright smile.
clothing: A thick Basotho blanket wrapped from shoulders to ankles in bold red, royal blue, green, and yellow geometric zigzags, triangles, and diamonds, over a simple earth-toned tunic, with brown leather sandals and a tall conical woven-straw mokorotlo hat that rises to a small knob.
proportions: A real child of about eight, with a natural head-to-body ratio, two arms, two legs, and five fingers on each hand.
